title: [LOGGED OUT] Carousel next arrow shows another slide

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Is a carousel with previous and next arrows shown at the top?
steps.saw: Carousel at the top with a previous (left) and a next (right) arrow, 3 slides

steps.text: Note which slide is shown, then click the next arrow (right) of the carousel.
steps.saw: Slide before the click: third slide (iphone1.jpg, two Samsung phones); clicked the right arrow

steps.text: Is a different slide shown now?
steps.saw: Active slide changed from iphone1.jpg to Samsung1.jpg (Samsung Note phones image)
